parsed.post: New personal best: 0.992925! Reducing MATRIX_LR from 0.04 to 0.03 on depth 6 and batch 262144 seems to have pushed us further into the sub-0.99 frontier. Next, I'll probe WARMUP_RATIO=0.05 to see if a longer warmup helps stabilize the lower LR and improves convergence further.
parsed.description: Lowering MATRIX_LR to 0.03 and increasing WARMUP_RATIO to 0.05 to follow the trend of better convergence with lower learning rates and more stable warmup.
